svg.title: Ebb-and-flow nursery — Fill, hold & drain
svg.desc: Fill, hold & drain. 7 equipment references and 8 declared directed connections. Static illustrative symbols; arrows do not show instantaneous flow. This selected view does not include every plant connection.
svg.text: Fill, hold & drain · declared connections · illustrative equipment symbols
